setup.command: if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/go.tgz https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tgz && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/gofmt && rm /tmp/go.tgz; fi; cd frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile; mkdir -p "$HOME/Documents" "$HOME/Pictures" "$HOME/Videos"; printf 'Welcome to the BoxBox local preview.\nThis text file was generated by the sandbox setup script.\n' > "$HOME/Documents/welcome.txt"; if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ -f "$HOME/Pictures/aurora.png" ] || ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i gradients=s=1280x720:d=1 -frames:v 1 "$HOME/Pictures/aurora.png"; [ -f "$HOME/Videos/clip.mp4" ] || ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=24 -t 4 -pix_fmt yuv420p "$HOME/Videos/clip.mp4"; fi; true
